_comment: Exact extraction volume of jobs/q9_feature_cache per arm, produced locally on CPU by 'python -X utf8 -m jobs.q9_feature_cache.cache run --arm <arm> --plan-only --tok-s 22144 --call-s 0.0595' (2026-10-06/07) on the REAL inputs: train.train_set.draw over the pointer-verified 150k set (cohort-v2 exclusion, pinned D1-B exclusions, drawn-record heldout scan) with the content-index guard from jobs.m2_pilot.guard_ready (index sha256 7cbe6c89... reproduced locally), the private DEV rows (sha256 d1202ab8...), and the Qwen3.5-9B tokenizer @ c2022362. positions / calls = what extract.extract_request runs (tests/test_q9_feature_cache.py checks the volume model against the calls actually made). plan_minutes_local = tokenisation + draw wall time on a laptop CPU (three arms in parallel). Calls were planned before extract.KV_COPY_TOKENS (long-row KV-copy cap: <= 2**19 copied cache tokens per call) was added; it adds calls only for rows whose cached prefix exceeds 16,384 tokens (positions unchanged), so the committed calls are a slight lower bound there. The in-job preflight recomputes the exact volume with the shipped code before the model loads.
